Data quality work: The rules file specifies flipper_length_mm must be 170–235 mm. Three rows (46, 47, 63) had impossible negative values (-215, -228, -198) and were excluded from the analysis (approved). Species labels were clean and matched the allowed values, and there were no duplicate rows. Other issues not affecting this question (left as-is): island label variants ("torgersen", "Dream "), body_mass_g stored as text with commas, and 2 missing sex values. The averages are based on 61 of 64 rows.
